## Entry #20 — 2026-01-05 — DECISION: Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)

**Status**: completed
**Source**: ADR documentation

### What Happened
Created comprehensive Architecture Decision Records documenting key technical decisions:
- ADR-001: Use Hono.js instead of Express
- ADR-002: Use Supabase (PostgreSQL) for Database and Auth  
- ADR-003: Use MobileMessage.com.au for SMS Delivery
- ADR-004: No Native App — Web-Only via SMS Link
- ADR-002: Hard Deletes Over Soft Deletes

- `docs/4-decisions/ADR/004-no-app-install.md`
